name: monitor_google_ads
description: Inspects active and newly launched Google ads, ad copy, and creative history for competitor domains or advertiser IDs via Google Ads Transparency Center.

targets.description: List of domains (e.g. 'hubspot.com') or advertiser IDs (e.g. 'AR10072600183532683265').

mode.description: 'monitor' returns ads launched since last check; 'all' returns most recent ads.
